final_claim: For the stated three-mode spectral perturbation of two exact-line-search steepest-descent steps, the first variation of the squared Euclidean error ratio has the displayed cubic factor, with a sharp conditioning frontier at the unique \(\kappa_0>1\) root of the displayed reciprocal degree-eight polynomial, \(\kappa_0\approx13.16265037573856\); above it an arbitrarily small interior mode can worsen the balanced two-mode benchmark.
limitations: The theorem is local to the specified mass-preserving perturbation and does not determine the global worst two-step Euclidean contraction.
